source_title: Postmarketing Safety Surveillance of Beta-2 Adrenergic Receptor Agonists

paragraphs.text: In a cohort of 15,000 patients exposed to a 5 mg daily dose, adverse drug reaction (ADR) events involving the β2-adrenergic receptor (β2-AR) did not increase significantly (p = 0.24; Fig. 1A) [1].
While these preliminary findings may suggest acceptable tolerability at 25 °C storage, results are limited to short-term follow-up and require further validation.
